main.description: Create or update a role and its grant. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

name.description: What the role is called. Written as the role record's displayName.

bot.description: Whether people with this role are bots: accounts that act on their own, not a person. Giving someone a bot role is how they are marked as one. Omitted keeps the role's current value.

default.description: Whether members get this role when they join. Omitted keeps the role's current value.

actions.description: What the role may do. Written as the scopes that grant each, beside any other scope the role already holds.

assignable.description: The roles holders may give or take, each one the group defines or this one. Omitted keeps the role's current value.

repoCollections.description: Collections holders may write in the group's public repo as the group, `*` for any; written as `repo:` scopes. Omitted keeps the role's current value.

errors.name: LastConfigurer
errors.description: It would leave the group with nobody able to configure it.
